title: How to solve any projectile problem (steps)
where: projectile_notes.docx (How to solve any projectile problem (steps))
ref: projectile_notes.docx How to solve any projectile problem (steps)
details: steps: Write down what is given: launch speed u, angle theta, and g = 9.8 m/s^2. -> Split the launch speed: ux = u cos theta (horizontal), uy = u sin theta (vertical). -> Maximum height: h = uy^2 / (2g). -> Time of flight: T = 2 uy / g. -> Range: R = ux x T, which is the same as R = u^2 sin 2theta / g. -> Check the answer against the book, or by running the program below.
use_why: it is a process to draw step by step
